passenger_response.subject: Update on booking AER-5C9X3T
passenger_response.body:
Dear Greg Whitmore,

The record shows that flight AK229 on 2026-08-05 was cancelled because the operating crew were out of hours following a previous-day disruption, and no standby crew were available at LHR.

Your request to be re-booked on the earliest available Geneva flight on Monday 10 August needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

The proposed option was re-booking onto AK151 on 2026-08-10, departing 05:00 and arriving 06:32. It could not be confirmed because it carries an additional fare of GBP 311.58.

Compensation cannot be assessed until your re-routing, or refusal of re-routing, is settled. The arrival delay at your final destination is not yet known because you have not been re-routed.

As the flight was cancelled, you are entitled to care immediately. This includes meals and refreshments up to GBP 30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to GBP 180 per room per night for a maximum of 3 nights subject to station allocation, and transport up to GBP 45 per journey.

Your request to stop marketing messages needs a colleague to review it. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
